name: app
description: NovaCart e-commerce application with a React frontend and Spring Boot microservices

scripts.backend:build: cd backend/auth-service && ./mvnw clean package && cd ../product-service && ./mvnw clean package && cd ../order-service && ./mvnw clean package
scripts.test: cd frontend && npm test && cd ../backend/auth-service && ./mvnw test && cd ../product-service && ./mvnw test && cd ../order-service && ./mvnw test
